meta.name: Hack Crimes Online
meta.description:
The season initially focuses on Shakti's induction in the cybercrime unit alongside Jigar and Girish, and how they transform into an indomitable force solving extreme cybercrime cases under the tutelage of ACP Ashutosh.

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 10 Nov 2023 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Friday Storytellers · Network: Amazon miniTV

videos.title: Gamma Road
videos.overview: We are introduced to the enigma that is Shakti, a standoffish and talented girl with a feisty spirit. Ashutosh, the head of the new cyber crime special unit, puts her skills as a hacker to the test.

videos.title: Skin Game
videos.overview: The team has to investigate the suicide of a school girl who became the victim of cyber bullying. They uncover a dark crime ring that exploits innocent girls and must now work to stop it before another teen loses her life.

videos.title: The Spoof
videos.overview: The team is called to help when 73 crore rupees vanish from a company's bank account. Shakti then has to juggle a legal blame-game as well as uncover the true culprit.

videos.title: Breaking News
videos.overview: An eccentric news presenter's private data has been leaked. But as Shakti and the team get involved, the situation devolves into a kidnapping with much darker motives, the climax of which becomes breaking news.

videos.title: Stealth Mode
videos.overview: A 'green' company's CEO has allegedly received funding from an international criminal organisation and all their operations have been frozen. Shakti and Ashutosh uncover the truth and must now hunt down the real perpetrator.

videos.title: Hacker In The House
videos.overview: A business family is falling apart as disturbing WhatsChat messages begin mysteriously appearing on their phones. The familial blame-game reaches a breaking-point, when our team is called in to help.

videos.title: Twisted Love
videos.overview: A powerful politician approaches Shakti privately to help find her missing lover. However, as Shakti investigates, she uncovers a dark secret that devolves into a sensational scandal of much larger proportions

videos.title: Jackpotting - Part 1
videos.overview: ATMs in the city begin randomly spewing money. The team discovers that a nefarious group has planted a malware in several bank servers, allowing them access to ATMs in the city.

videos.title: Jackpotting - Part 2
videos.overview: The team has to not only find a way to remove the malware, but also track down the perpetrators before they flee with the money.
